purpose: Teach: 版画/トランク/牡蠣/酒場/風呂敷/ヒーター/白髪/笹

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、美術部で版画やったろ?
lines.en: Riku, you did woodblock printing in the art club, didn't you?
lines.style: Bright, direct question. Quick pace, genuine curiosity without neediness. Slight uptick on the tag question at the end — testing whether he'll actually answer.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、修学旅行のトランク、重そうだな、桜
lines.en: Your school-trip luggage looked heavy, Sakura.
lines.style: Deflecting observation masked as casual comment. Dry tone, looking away slightly. Doesn't expect an answer — just noticing out loud.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、家族で牡蠣食べに行ったろ?
lines.en: Riku, your family went out for oysters, didn't they?
lines.style: Rapid-fire question, same brightness as before. She's testing something — watching to see if he'll keep dodging. A little more insistent than the first one.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前のお父さん、酒場のマスターなんだろ?桜
lines.en: Your dad's a tavern owner, right, Sakura?
lines.style: Matching her pace now, but still evasive. Questions instead of answers. Soft, almost interested tone — but the deflection is deliberate.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、社会で風呂敷の文化やったろ?
lines.en: Riku, you covered the history of furoshiki wrapping cloth in social studies, didn't you?
lines.style: Same bright curiosity, but slightly longer question. Patient. She's giving him room to say something real. The rhythm is almost playful now.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前ん家、新しいヒーター入れたろ?桜
lines.en: Your house got a new heater installed, didn't it, Sakura?
lines.style: His questions are getting smaller, softer. This one sounds almost like he's asking about something safe. Quieter than before. Still evasive, but there's something underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前のお父さん、白髪増えてんな
lines.en: Riku, your dad's got more gray hair now.
lines.style: Observation, not a question. Slight dryness returns. She's noticed something real about him — something that matters. Softer delivery than the earlier teasing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、七夕で笹に願い事書いたろ?桜
lines.en: You wrote a wish on the bamboo leaves for Tanabata, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Quieter than his previous questions. Slower pace. Almost vulnerable — like he's asking about something that mattered to him. The tag feels genuine, not evasive.
